import analysis.complex.basic
import data.complex.lseries
import data.real.basic
import data.zmod.basic

open Complex LSeries

theorem lg_target {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (Φ : ZMod N → ℂ) {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) : LSeriesSummable (fun x => Φ ↑x) s := by
  let M : ℝ := ∥Φ ∘ natCast ∘ ZMod.val ∥
  let x : ℝ := s.re
  have h_bounded : ∀ n : ℕ, ∥Φ ↑n∥ ≤ M := by
    intro n
    rw [ZMod.val_injective]
    have h : ∀ m : ZMod N, ∥Φ m∥ ≤ M := by
      apply_le_sup_norm_comp
      exact fun m => norm_nonneg (Φ m)
    exact h (ZMod.ofNat n)
  have h_big_o : (fun n => Φ ↑n) =O[Filter.atTop] fun n => ↑n ^ (x - 1) := by
    refine isBigO_const_pow (x - 1) _ _
    · exact (show 0 < x - 1, from gt_iff_lt.1 (lt.trans (gt_iff_lt.2 hs) (sub_pos_iff_right.2 (lt_add_right zero_lt_one))))
    · intro n
      exact le_rpow_of_le (le_refl _) (le_refl _) (le_trans (le_zero (norm_nonneg (Φ ↑n))) (le_rpow_of_nonneg (le_refl _) (le_refl _)))
  refine LSeriesSummable_of_isBigO_rpow x h_big_o
